notes: Large-source-unit יוֹם בְּיוֹם → 'daily' is genuinely indivisible: the lone adverb spends nothing on either occurrence (rule 22 lone-adverb limit), so the fusion is retained.

דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ: first יוֹם takes 'of every day' as the distributive rendering (rules 15, 19, 22); the second יוֹם, its בְּ and suffix are unrepresented; 'as' and 'required' are two added units separated by rendered material.
